rows.text: stores `dl` to byte `+0x244` of `rcx`; then, for index `ebx` from 0 while `ebx` is below (signed) dword `+0x20` of the object returned by `001AD670` + 0xE (re-fetched each pass at + 0x50), computes a flag that is 1 when byte `+0x1C` of the result of `001AD670` + 0x20 is non-zero, calls `001AD670` + 0x3C with the object from `001AD670` + 0x2F, that flag and the index, and when this returns non-null passes the result to `001AD670` + 0x49; a count of 0 or less skips the loop
calls `00358420` + 0xB with (`ecx` 0, `edx` 1), then the same callee at `00358420` + 0x15 with (`ecx` 1, `edx` 0), then stores byte 0 to `022C7F99`
stores `cl` to byte `022CBA91` and `edx` to dword `022CBA84`
stores `ecx` to dword `022CBB30` when `ecx` is greater than 0 (signed), else stores `0xB4` (180)

for each index below dword `02EBCAA0` (signed, re-read every pass; nothing when 0 or less) takes qword `02EBCA80` + 8*i and, when it and the record returned for it by `003B7510` + 0x3B are both non-null, calls `003B7510` + 0x56 with (object, record, record+4, record+8) and `003B7510` + 0x6A with (object, record+0x10, record+0x14, record+0x18), stores the byte from `003B7510` + 0x72 to record byte `+0x64`, and stores the floats from `003B7510` + 0x7D to `+0x34`, from `003B7510` + 0x8A to `+0x24` and from `003B7510` + 0x97 (the same callee as + 0x7D) to `+0x34` again

adds the three floats at `rcx`, `rcx+4`, `rcx+8` into the floats at `r8`, `r8+4`, `r8+8` in place; when `rdx` is non-null it then copies the three sums to dwords `+0x30`, `+0x34`, `+0x38` of `rdx`, copies the second sum also to dword `+0xAC`, and stores word `0xFFFF` to `+0x82`
